posts.quoted: OpenClaw, Hermes Agent and Prime Agent don't meaningfully learn from experience. On Continual-ARC, our new benchmark at @letsunifyai, none of them were able to memorize anything of value and none were able to generalize to new tasks. Training a small 9B model's weights did both.
